purpose: Provide real articulated run, windup, strike, and recovery poses for the retained Dasher B scrap runner in five-minute-overdrive gameplay.
camera: fixed top-down three-quarter orthographic game camera pitched approximately 45 degrees
facing: six right-facing action masters; flip horizontally at runtime when the player is to the left
lighting: controlled cyan rim light with restrained magenta emission and an alpha-based runtime contrast outline
prompt: Turn the approved Dasher B low-slung scrap runner into a strict 3 by 2 animation sheet: three articulated reverse-jointed run poses followed by compressed windup, extended forward strike, and recovery; preserve chassis identity, volume, right-facing 45-degree camera, opaque core, clean alpha, and consistent scale.
negative_constraints: no whole-body spin, simple scale-only animation, identity drift, camera drift, duplicate pose, rider, or wheels
no weapon, projectile, motion trail, environment, text, watermark, cropped legs, extra limbs, or detached parts
do not change collision, speed, health, damage, AI, attack timing, or behavior
generation_model: imagegen built-in plus deterministic connected-background removal and six-component grid repacking
